learning_modalities.visual_spatial: Learns via diagrams, spatial sandboxes, color-coded mind maps, and 3D simulations.
learning_modalities.auditory_verbal: Learns via Socratic dialogue, storytelling, rhythm, and peer teaching.
learning_modalities.kinesthetic_experiential: Learns via hands-on building, movement breaks, rapid 12-min sprints, and arcade mechanics.
learning_modalities.analytical_systems: Learns via first-principles decomposition, rule discovery, and logic trees.

GREEN.label: Green — Thriving & Talent Acceleration
GREEN.criteria: Balanced bio-rhythms, stable mood, healthy screen boundaries. Focus on unlocking advanced talent quests and optimizing learning velocity.

AMBER.label: Amber — Multi-Factor Coaching Intervention
AMBER.criteria: 2+ converging risk signals (e.g., sleep < 6.5h, late-night social media > 45m, low nutritional energy, or growing game frustration). Triggers synchronized Parent + Teacher + Student habit quests.

RED.label: Red — Urgent Counselor & Family Safeguarding
RED.criteria: Acute emotional distress, severe burnout, persistent isolation, or safety/self-harm indicators. Immediate human counselor triage required.
